note: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Three inputs: design-system/guidelines/figma/token-mapping.md (curated semantics, authoritative), scripts/figma-variables-snapshot.json (resolved by codeSyntax.WEB first, falling back to name rules when absent; archived/* collections skipped) and design-system/src/tokens/color/figma-spec.json (the generated --ds- color variables, read by their code syntax; the "color / foundations" paths come from this spec until the Figma push lands and the snapshot holds them). Every token in all three is validated against design-system/src/tokens/*.scss and design-system/src/tokens/color/*.scss. Run `npm run generate:token-registry`.
